subject: Orderly Systems onboarding: order id issuance blocked by spend cap / line items
messages:
From: Sarah Mills <sarah.mills@orderly.co>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: finance@orderly.co
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding paperwork submitted — PO still pending

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking the call this morning. We submitted the onboarding packet and the vendor forms via the portal (attached), but our procurement team is hitting a hard stop: we don’t have an Order/PO number yet and finance can’t schedule the initial invoice without it.

Can you confirm the expected timeline for issuance? We also noticed a note on your intake portal that indicates a spend cap row is required for first-quarter pilot deals; we didn’t see where to provide that on the form. If that’s blocking issuance I can send the requested cap/ledger mapping.

Attached: Orderly_Onboarding_Packet.pdf, Orderly_W9.pdf

Appreciate any quick guidance — we have planned a supplier kickoff next week and the vendor team needs an official ref.

Best,
Sarah Mills
Head of Operations, Orderly Systems
S: 415-555-0198

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Mills <sarah.mills@orderly.co>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.com, connor.obrien@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding paperwork submitted — PO still pending

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for sending these over and for the call. Short answer: issuance is blocked by two things on our side: 1) the procurement intake flagged an ambiguous spend cap for the pilot (we need the explicit spend ceiling and preferred billing cadence), and 2) one of your invoice line descriptions ("Platform access - pilot") needs to be split into 2 line items for tax/chargeback purposes (software subscription + professional services).

Looping in Priyom (procurement) and Connor (vendor ops) to help. Priyom — can you confirm whether we can create a provisional order reference so Orderly can submit the initial invoice next week while we formalize the spend cap and line splits? If not, what is the earliest issuance date assuming Orderly returns the attached corrected invoice (I’ve attached their packet here for your convenience).

Sarah — if you can provide the preferred pilot spend cap (e.g., $XX,XXX) and whether billing will be monthly or one-time, that will speed this. Also please confirm who should be the invoice recipient (company/legal entity).

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Sr. Manager, Strategic Procurement
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Orderly_Onboarding_Packet.pdf

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, sarah.mills@orderly.co
Cc: connor.obrien@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding paperwork submitted — PO still pending

Kimberly / Sarah —

Thanks for the summary. I reviewed the packet and the portal flags. Two quick notes:

- Spend cap: for pilots we require an explicit pilot ceiling to be recorded in the PO metadata. If Orderly confirms a pilot cap of $25,000 and monthly billing, we can proceed with provisional routing.
- Line items: our ledger requires separation of subscription vs services for cost center tagging. We need the vendor to provide a corrected invoice that splits the $12,000 "Platform access - pilot" into: 
  1) "Platform subscription (pilot)" — $8,000
  2) "Implementation / onboarding services" — $4,000

Operational workaround: we can issue a provisional internal order reference (TEMP-ORD-7821) today to allow the finance team to accept an initial invoice for onboarding work. Full, formal PO issuance (PO-2026-08934) will follow once the corrected invoice and the signed MSLA are in our queue and spend cap is entered.

Sarah — please upload the corrected invoice (I attached a quick template) and confirm the pilot cap and billing cadence. I’ll open HS ticket HS-458721 and set the procurement status to "provisional reference issued" so finance has a trail.

Connor — can you validate that TEMP-ORD-7821 will be accepted by our AP intake for payment holds?

Thanks,
Priyom
Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Corrected_Invoice_LineSplit.xlsx

From: Sarah Mills <sarah.mills@orderly.co>
To: priyom.das@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: finance@orderly.co
Date: Thu, 2 Jul 2026 08:19:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding paperwork submitted — PO still pending

Priyom / Kimberly —

Thanks — we can do that. Confirming: pilot spend cap $25,000, billing monthly. I've attached the corrected invoice with the split into subscription and services and included Orderly Systems (Orderly Systems, Inc.) as the invoice recipient. W9 is also attached above.

We accept the provisional ref TEMP-ORD-7821 for initial onboarding invoices. Our finance team will submit the initial invoice under that reference tomorrow.

Quick question: will provisional reference impact tax reporting or ledger tagging on your end? We just want to make sure the temporary code won't cause any downstream reconciliation work for our team.

Sarah

Attachment: Corrected_Invoice_LineSplit.xlsx

All —

Confirmed: procurement has recorded the provisional reference TEMP-ORD-7821 and finance will accept the initial onboarding invoice under that reference. Priyom — I’ve flagged HS-458721 to require follow-up when the formal PO number is created. Please route the final MSLA and the corrected invoice into the HubSpot ticket and we’ll transition to PO-2026-08934 once legal finishes the signature (DocuSign link attached).

Orderly — expected next steps for you:
- Upload signed MSLA via DocuSign (use the link in HS ticket)
- Confirm invoice submitted under TEMP-ORD-7821 (finance will process as onboarding expense)
- Expect formal PO (PO-2026-08934) in 3–5 business days after the MSLA is fully signed and spend cap is officially recorded.

Connor — please confirm after you see the invoice in AP intake that the provisional flow completed without rejections.
